local function MakeDraggable(topbarobject, object)
	local Dragging = nil
	local DragInput = nil
	local DragStart = nil
	local StartPosition = nil

	local function Update(input)
		local Delta = input.Position - DragStart
		local pos =
			UDim2.new(
				StartPosition.X.Scale,
				StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				StartPosition.Y.Scale,
				StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
			)
		object.Position = pos
	end

	topbarobject.InputBegan:Connect(
		function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				Dragging = true
				DragStart = input.Position
				StartPosition = object.Position

				input.Changed:Connect(
					function()
						if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
							Dragging = false
						end
					end
				)
			end
		end
	)

	topbarobject.InputChanged:Connect(
		function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				DragInput = input
			end
		end
	)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(
		function(input)
			if input == DragInput and Dragging then
				Update(input)
			end
		end
	)
end

					elementData.element.ImageColor3 = newColor

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
env.__ChatBlocker = env.__ChatBlocker or { enabled = false, hooked = false }
local State = env.__ChatBlocker

if State.unload then
    pcall(State.unload)
end

local function isLegacyChatRemote(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance"
        and inst.ClassName == "RemoteEvent"
        and inst.Name == "SayMessageRequest"
end

local function isTextChannel(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst.ClassName == "TextChannel"
end

if not State.hooked then
    State.hooked = true

    if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
        local oldNamecall
        oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
            if State.enabled then
                local method = getnamecallmethod()
                if method == "FireServer" and isLegacyChatRemote(self) then
                    return
                end
                if method == "SendAsync" and isTextChannel(self) then
                    return
                end
            end
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end))
    else
        warn("[ChatBlocker] executor has no hookmetamethod, namecall hook will not be installed")
    end

    if hookfunction then
        local function hookMethod(className, methodName, check)
            pcall(function()
                local dummy = Instance.new(className)
                local orig
                orig = hookfunction(dummy[methodName], newcclosure(function(self, ...)
                    if State.enabled and check(self) then
                        return
                    end
                    return orig(self, ...)
                end))
                dummy:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        hookMethod("RemoteEvent", "FireServer", isLegacyChatRemote)
        hookMethod("TextChannel", "SendAsync", isTextChannel)
    end
end

local function setInputBar(blocked)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
        if not cfg then
            return
        end
        if blocked then
            if State.prevBar == nil then
                State.prevBar = cfg.Enabled
            end
            cfg.Enabled = false
        elseif State.prevBar ~= nil then
            cfg.Enabled = State.prevBar
            State.prevBar = nil

    end)
end

    if estado == false then
        stopFly()
        return
    end

    local character = LP.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    local humanoid =
        character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    local root =
        character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root then
        return
    end

    flying = true

    -- VELOCIDADE
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name = "RickXFlyVelocity"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
        math.huge,
        math.huge,
        math.huge
    )
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.Parent = root

    -- ORIENTACAO
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.Name = "RickXFlyGyro"
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(
        math.huge,
        math.huge,
        math.huge
    )
    bg.P = 9000
    bg.D = 500
    bg.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
    bg.Parent = root

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
        function()
            if not flying then
                return
            end

            if not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then
                stopFly()
                return
            end

            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not camera then
                return
            end

            local direction = Vector3.zero

            -- JOYSTICK DO CELULAR
            local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
            local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector

            local flatLook = Vector3.new(
                look.X, 0, look.Z
            )

            local flatRight = Vector3.new(
                right.X, 0, right.Z
            )

            if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
                flatLook = flatLook.Unit
            end

            if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
                flatRight = flatRight.Unit
            end

            if move.Magnitude > 0 then
                local forwardAmount = move:Dot(flatLook)
                local rightAmount = move:Dot(flatRight)

                direction =
                    look * forwardAmount
                    + flatRight * rightAmount
            end

            -- TECLADO DO PC
            if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                    direction += look
                end

                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                    direction -= look
                end

                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                    direction -= right
                end

                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                    direction += right
                end

                -- SUBIR
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                    direction += Vector3.yAxis
                end

                -- DESCER
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                    direction -= Vector3.yAxis
                end
            end

            if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                direction = direction.Unit * FLY_SPEED
            else
                direction = Vector3.zero
            end

            bv.Velocity = direction
            bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
        end
    )

    if flyButton then
        flyButton.Text = "FLY: ON"
    end
